hooks.command: in=$(sed -E 's/\\[ntr]/ /g'); m() { printf '%s' "$in" | grep -qiE "$1"; }; G='(^|[^a-z])git([" ]+[^" &|;]+)*[" ]+'; a=; m "$G"'(commit|push|rebase|tag|reset[" ]+--hard|branch[" ]+-D)([" &|;]|$)|(^|[^a-z])gh[" ]+pr[" ]+merge|--force(-with-lease)?' && a=1; m "$G"'(switch[" ]+(-c|-C|--create|--force-create)|checkout[" ]+(-b|-B)|branch)[" ]+[^" &|;-][^" &|;]*[" ]+[^" &|;-][^" &|;]*/' && ! m 'no-track' && a=1; m "$G"'(switch|checkout|branch)([" ]+[^" &|;]+)*[" ]+(--track|-t)([" =]|$)' && a=1; m "$G"'branch([" ]+[^" &|;]+)*[" ]+(-u|--set-upstream-to)([" =]|$)' && a=1; m "$G"'remote[" ]+(add|set-url|rename|remove|rm|set-branches|set-head)([" ]|$)' && a=1; m "$G"'config[^&|;]*(branch|remote|push|url)\.' && ! m "$G"'config[^&|;]*(--get|--list|[" ]-l([" ]|$)|[" ](get|list)[" ])' && a=1; [ -n "$a" ] && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"CoreAiRules: git history or remote writes, and changes to upstream tracking, remotes or push configuration, require explicit approval"}}' || true
